feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
entry.summary: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.

entry.title: U.K. accuses Israeli settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' in West Bank and bans their goods
entry.summary: France, Canada and other countries joined the U.K. in banning goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel said it would close the British Consulate among other measures.

entry.title: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
entry.summary: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight.

entry.title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
entry.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

entry.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
entry.summary: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

entry.title: World Food Programme's Carl Skau discusses Yemen's food insecurity crisis
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Carl Skau of the World Food Programme about the food insecurity crisis in Yemen.

entry.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
entry.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

entry.title: King Charles III clarifies status of Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan
entry.summary: King Charles III has reiterated that Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, remain non-working members of the royal family following their return to the United Kingdom.

entry.title: Russia and North Korea open the first road across their shared border
entry.summary: Relations between Russia and North Korea have been flourishing, with North Korea supplying ammunition and troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine in return for economic and military assistance.

entry.title: The UN passed resolution ahead of General Assembly calling for end to child marriage
entry.summary: The UN estimates 650 million women and girls currently alive were married before age 18. A new resolution aims to bring awareness and push countries to act to end child marriage.
